markets.notes: CM district substantially amended post-2022 ($30/SF contribution >5 stories; Strode-block 3-story base/5-story cap; 30-ft rear Type E buffer). No FAR/density/coverage caps in CM. All large PBSH since 2023 entitled via negotiated PD, not straight rezoning. BAR Certificate of Approval precedes building permit. Election: 3 council seats Nov 3, 2026.

markets.notes: One countywide ordinance (no city/county split). No minimum parking citywide. Use variances prohibited (§7-6(b)(2)). Comp plan = Imagine Lexington 2045 (Placetypes via Placebuilder; KRS 100.213 findings). WARNING: platform 'future land use' fields are PVA current-use codes, NOT placetypes. Council rejected UK-area student rezoning 8-7 Nov 2025 (Aylesford/Core Spaces — historic demolition). Infill & Redevelopment Area allows 50% BoA parking reduction.
